Flights, visas, hotels, Indian vegetarian meals, entry tickets and a private coach are all included, so you simply pack and enjoy.

Snow on Mount Titlis · Lucerne → Interlaken

Ride the revolving Rotair cable car up Mount Titlis to play in the snow, walk through the Glacier Cave, cross the Cliff Walk and ride the Ice Flyer. In Lucerne, see the Lion Monument and Chapel Bridge, cruise the lake for an hour and take the scenic Luzern–Interlaken Express.
The Rotair was the world’s first revolving cable car, and the Titlis Cliff Walk is Europe’s highest suspension bridge, at over 3,000 m.
